name: tabmaker
description: Paste a song link, get guitar tab

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=public/app.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('node_modules/@spotify/basic-pitch/model','public/model',{recursive:true});const mp='node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/';fs.mkdirSync('public/mediapipe/wasm',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(mp+'vision_bundle.mjs','public/mediapipe/vision_bundle.mjs');for(const f of ['vision_wasm_internal.js','vision_wasm_internal.wasm'])fs.copyFileSync(mp+'wasm/'+f,'public/mediapipe/wasm/'+f);const tw='node_modules/@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-wasm/dist/';fs.mkdirSync('public/tfjs-wasm',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['tfjs-backend-wasm.wasm','tfjs-backend-wasm-simd.wasm','tfjs-backend-wasm-threaded-simd.wasm'])fs.copyFileSync(tw+f,'public/tfjs-wasm/'+f)"
